notes: Fixed: Radio no longer shows stations that aren't Indian. A station used to qualify for the Radio lists by declaring a language, whatever country it broadcast from - so 224 foreign stations reached every category and every search, 118 of them American sports-talk radio ("1010 XL", "103.5 The Game", "1340 The Fan") that got in purely by being in English; a station now known to be foreign is left out whatever language it declares, and Sports is unchanged because that category is meant to be worldwide. Fixed: a Pakistani station could show up as an Indian one - Punjab is the name of a state in both countries and a station's state was being read on its own, so "FM 100 Pakistan Jhelum" was labelled Punjab and appeared under the Punjab filter; the country is checked first now. Fixed: filter chips that returned nothing are gone - the Category, Language and State chips were built from the whole downloaded list rather than the stations the list can actually show, so a chip could exist with no results behind it; they are built from the same set as the results now. Improved: station and channel names are cleaner - around 450 radio stations and 480 TV channels used to publish whatever decoration their source carried, a distributor's channel number ("352 IDHAYAM TV"), a transcode tag ("Aaj Tak (1080p)", "[Not 24/7]"), an undecoded apostrophe ("Easy 90's"), a raw web address used as a name ("aby_tamil_fm") or a bitrate tail, while names that genuinely carry a bracket like "Akashvani Kalaburgi (Gulbarga)" are untouched. Improved: High quality only now works for far more stations - roughly half the catalogue reported no bitrate at all so the filter had nothing to judge them by, and their real bitrate is read straight off the stream now. Improved: TV languages - 42% of TV channels had no language at all and matched no language filter, because the channel data source had quietly moved that field somewhere it was never being read; regional channels also no longer inherit the wrong language from the national brand they are named after ("Colors Super" is Kannada, not Hindi). Improved: every TV channel now has a real category - 274 channels carried something that was never a category to begin with, a distributor's regional bundle name, a language, or the uploader's own advertising, and so matched no category chip at all. New: Pakistani radio - radio-pakistan.com's full directory, 121 stations with 102 of them live, is now in the catalogue, tagged with its own country and province so it never mixes into the Indian listings.
